description: Screenshot of Q drop #2994, dated 6 Mar 2019, titled 'Wake Up People! See Through Their Division Tactics', shown in a dark-themed Q aggregator interface with the tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI. The drop claims people are pawns in a game of global domination and are deliberately divided (race, religion, political, class, sex) to prevent an uprising against the ruling class, urging patriots to stay united. The word 'DIVIDED' is highlighted in red four times, apparently a search-term highlight.
text: 2994. Wake Up People! See Through Their Division Tactics. Q !!mG7VJxZNCI 6 Mar 2019 - 11:34:41 PM. PEOPLE ARE PAWNS IN THEIR SICK GAME OF GLOBAL DOMINATION. PEOPLE ARE DIVIDED TO PREVENT A RISING OF THE PEOPLE. PEOPLE ARE DIVIDED AND TAUGHT TO FIGHT THEMSELVES INSTEAD OF THE RULING CLASS. RACE VS RACE. RELIGION VS RELIGION. POLITICAL VS POLITICAL. CLASS VS CLASS. SEX VS SEX. WHEN YOU ARE DIVIDED, YOU ARE WEAK. WHEN YOU ARE WEAK, YOU HAVE NO POWER. WHEN YOU HAVE NO POWER, YOU HAVE NO CONTROL. STAY STRONG, PATRIOTS. STAY UNITED, NOT DIVIDED. YOU ARE WHAT MATTERS. YOU, AWAKE, IS THEIR GREATEST FEAR. Q
flags: Q-drop content transcribed is the drop's claim, not fact

description: Mobile screenshot of a New York Post article headline dated March 5, 2018, by Nicolas Vega: 'Facebook survey asks users if they condone pedophilia'. The lead photo shows Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg speaking at a microphone in a dark hoodie before a blue backdrop with large question marks, credited to AFP/Getty Images. Social-sharing icons (Facebook, Twitter, Google+, Messenger, WhatsApp, email, link) appear beneath the masthead.
text: NEW YORK POST. Facebook survey asks users if they condone pedophilia. By Nicolas Vega. March 5, 2018 | 3:13pm | Updated. Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg. AFP/Getty Images

description: Screenshot of Q drop #1886 (board post No. 158), dated Aug 15 2018, posted under tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, marked NEW in an aggregator view. The drop consists entirely of two Bible quotations: a verse attributed to Corinthians 13:4-13 ('For now we see only a reflection as in a mirror...') and the full 'armor of God' passage from Ephesians 6:10-18.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI No.158. 1886. Aug 15 2018 14:12:17 (EST) NEW. "For now we see only a reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.". – Corinthians 13:4-13. "Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power. Put on the full armor of God so that you can take your stand against the devil's schemes. For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms. Therefore put on the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you may be able to stand your ground, and after you have done everything, to stand. Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness in place, and with your feet fitted with the readiness that comes from the gospel of peace. In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one. Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God. And pray in the Spirit on all occasions with all kinds of prayers and requests. With this in mind, be alert and always keep on praying for all the saints.". – Ephesians 6:10-18
flags: Quoted verse cited as 'Corinthians 13:4-13' is actually 1 Corinthians 13:12 as rendered in the NIV

description: Photoshopped movie-poster-style meme titled 'The Jihad Squad', targeting the four Democratic congresswomen known as 'The Squad': Rashida Tlaib, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Ilhan Omar, and Ayanna Pressley. Their heads are composited onto action-movie figures — Omar in a grey hijab beside an upright shotgun, Pressley aiming a pistol, Tlaib shouting in a suit, and Ocasio-Cortez in a red dress standing in flames. Taglines call their politics 'political jihad' and mock accusations of racism; this widely circulated 2019 meme drew condemnation when shared by the Illinois Republican County Chairmen's Association.
text: Rashida Tlaib. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. Ilhan Omar. Ayanna Pressley. THE JIHAD SQUAD. POLITICAL JIHAD IS THEIR GAME. IF YOU DON'T AGREE WITH THEIR SOCIALIST IDEOLOGY, YOU'RE RACIST
flags: Derogatory/Islamophobic political attack meme; composited fake imagery, not real photographs of the subjects with weapons

description: Screenshot of a Facebook-style link preview from sosharethis.com headlined 'President Trump nominates Marine to be first-ever black female general. Let's congratulate her!'. The preview pairs an official U.S. Marine Corps portrait of a Black female officer in dress uniform with ribbons, flanked by the U.S. and Marine Corps flags, with a candid photo of the same officer gesturing in woodland MARPAT camouflage among other Marines. The officer is not named in the visible text; the imagery and 2018 headline are consistent with Brig. Gen. Lorna Mahlock, the first Black woman nominated as a Marine Corps brigadier general.
text: SOSHARETHIS.COM. President Trump nominates Marine to be first-ever black female general. Let's congratulate her!
flags: Officer not named in visible text; identification as Lorna Mahlock inferred from headline context, probable but not certain
Donald Trump named in headline but not pictured
